shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents the rear curved base boundary that is hidden from this viewing direction. Right image: It is a horizontal auxiliary construction line through the upper vertex of the plane diagram.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashes extend a horizontal reference from the top vertex in a plane trigonometric construction. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
